## Rio from above and from the water

A train through the Tijuca Forest takes you up to Christ the Redeemer, while a cable car connects Urca and Sugar Loaf. From the two summits, you can see the beaches, city neighbourhoods and Guanabara Bay. A separate day is set aside for the island trip: the city streets give way to the water and green shores of Angra dos Reis and Ilha Grande.

After three days of excursions, you have a free day in Rio. You can spend it by the ocean, walking around the city or relaxing at the hotel.
